Title: LSJ - Census Taker and 'any sabbat' clause

Messages.Author: Benird
Messages.Body:
Hi There,

Reading the text of Sensus Taker I've gota question about it's any
sabbat wording.

Could I tap a Black Hand with it that I control to force another
methusela's Sabbat vampires bleed up by 1? Similarly could I tap the
vampire with it to give another Methusela's Black Hand vamp +1
Intercept?

It's a bit cornercase but it would be a great way to burn a predator's
vamp, like Sha-Ennu, with Archon Investigation becasue you've forced
them to bleed you for 4. similarly if you've been flicked with
something like My Enemy's Enemy you coudl burn one of your prey's
vamps with Archon Investigation by forcing them to bleed you for 4.

"Census Taker
Master, 1 Pool
Unique Master. Put this card on a ready Black Hand vampire. During an
action, this Black Hand vampire can tap to give any other Sabbat
vampire +1 bleed or 2 additional votes for the current action. During
an action, this Black Hand vampire can tap to give any other Black
Hand vampire +1 intercept."

Messages.Author: tongu...@comcast.net
Messages.Body:
On Apr 15, 10:32 pm, "Benird" <ben...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi There,
>

> Could I tap a Black Hand with it that I control to force another
> methusela's Sabbat vampires bleed up by 1? Similarly could I tap the
> vampire with it to give another Methusela's Black Hand vamp +1
> Intercept?

I'd say yes you can.. It doesn't have explicit card text that says
"to a sabbat vampire you control" In addition, Pentex(TM) loves you
works the same way, only that card it is optional. My prey kept
letting my predator use that against me at the SoC prerelease.

> It's a bit cornercase but it would be a great way to burn a predator's
> vamp, like Sha-Ennu, with Archon Investigation becasue you've forced
> them to bleed you for 4. similarly if you've been flicked with
> something like My Enemy's Enemy you coudl burn one of your prey's
> vamps with Archon Investigation by forcing them to bleed you for 4.

Yeah a little bit of a cornercase. So many BH vampires have AUS or
dom/DOM bouncing a bleed can be more beneficial than an AI card slot.
An interesting note, you can even play census taker on another
methuselah's bh vampire. it doesnt specify a bh vampire you control.

but maybe lsj has mo'better knowledge or insight about your question
that didn't come to my light yet.

Piotr Andreikov has Census Taker and Banjoko has Tattoo Signal.
Banjoko bleeds and Piotr taps to give Banjoko +1 bleed. Can I now
untap Piotr with Tattoo Signal and tap him again for a further +1
bleed?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. "During X, (you may) do Y" limits you to once per X.
